title_as_printed: Experimental and calculated water content for liquid C3H8 in equilibrium with a hydrate.

footnotes_as_printed.a: Precision of pressure measurements calculated to be +-0.001 MPa.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Precision of temperature measurements was calculated to be +-0.1K.
footnotes_as_printed.c: Reproducibility for water content measurements is estimated to be 12 ppm at the 95% confidence interval.

pressure_note: p/MPa; not further defined (system pressure of the equilibrium loop, Keller calibrated transducer); pressure is total

value.what: water content of the liquid propane phase in equilibrium with sII hydrate, ppm (the text calls the TDLAS stability ppmv); mole or volume basis not explicitly stated, gas-phase symbol y

conversion_needs: ppm to mole fraction x1e-6 (assumed mole basis; not stated explicitly)
notes: Rows 0-5 at about 242-243 K, 6-11 at about 253 K, 12-16 at 263 K, 17-21 at 273 K, 22-26 at 276 K. Rows at 273.10-273.12 K are marginally below 273.15 K (below_273K). Phase is liquid propane (lle) in equilibrium with sII hydrate: regime hydrate applied to all rows. Horizontal rules separate temperature groups; no label rows. Uncertainty 12 ppm (95 %) is a general statement applying to every row. Temperatures drift 241.95-243.05 K within the nominal 242 K isotherm.
quality_remarks: ppm taken as a mole-fraction basis (x1e-6); the paper never states mole vs volume basis (text says ppmv only for the TDLAS signal stability). Basis adopted because the companion thesis (10.11575_prism_38486 Table 2.5) compares the same instrument readings with gravimetric mole fractions; this table is the journal copy of thesis Table 6.1, which is marked duplicate_of this table.
